title: Data Engineer
description:
Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need many more people to help us make our vision a reality.

Octopus Energy Generation (OEGEN) is a leader in sourcing, investing in, and managing a wide range of utility-scale renewable energy assets. As we continue to expand our investment base, we are dedicated to building a diverse team that reflects the communities we serve. Currently, we manage a global portfolio of over £8 billion in renewable energy assets.

We are committed to delivering best-in-class responsible investment activity, offering like-minded investors the means and products to invest their capital sustainably. It is our ambition to change the entire energy lifecycle and make every green electron matter, delivering the best outcomes for customers, investors, the environment and society, accelerating the transition to net zero.

OEGEN Data, Tech & Transformation Team 

We are embarking on a comprehensive transformation program designed to drive significant advancements in our business operations and technology landscape. Our primary goal is to transition from our current reliance on legacy systems and specialized off-the-shelf tools to a more integrated, AI-driven, and data-centric operational model. 

Leveraging insights and guidance from our other technically mature entities like Kraken and OE, we plan to adopt cutting-edge tools and capabilities, particularly in AI and Python-driven solutions. 

By investing in a diverse range of skills, we aim to create a hybrid team capable of operating in both our legacy and future environments, ultimately transforming OEGEN into an efficient, data-driven organization. 

About the role 

We’re looking for a Data Engineer who can own the journey of data from source systems to decision-ready outputs. You’ll build and maintain pipelines, model data, stand up dashboards, and integrate systems via APIs. In a team this size, you’ll also get involved in application development - building internal tools with Streamlit, FastAPI, or HTMX that put data directly in the hands of our investment and asset management teams. 

In your first 3 months you’ll have taken ownership of at least one critical pipeline from an external system into Databricks, and built or materially improved a reporting layer used by Fund Management or Asset Management. 

What you'll do 

- Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines in Databricks, ensuring data is reliable, timely, and well-documented. 

- Own and evolve our Databricks models - define schemas, enforce testing, and keep the warehouse clean. 

- Automate manual data processes using Python, replacing spreadsheets and ad-hoc workflows with robust, repeatable jobs. 

- Build performance dashboards and reports in Streamlit and HTMX (FastAPI) that Finance, Asset Management, and Fund Management actually use. 

- Integrate internal and third-party systems via REST APIs, improving data accessibility across the business. 

- Champion data quality - implement validation, monitoring, and governance practices that give stakeholders confidence in the numbers. 

- Collaborate directly with non-technical teams to understand their problems and translate them into data solutions. 

What you'll need 

- Strong SQL and Python skills, used daily for pipeline development, data modelling, and automation. 

- Experience with modern data stack tooling: a cloud data platform (Databricks preferred), and version control (Git/GitHub). 

- A solid understanding of data modelling, warehousing patterns, and ETL/ELT design. 

- To be comfortable working with Postgres or similar relational databases. 

- Clear communication - you can explain a data model to a fund manager and discuss trade-offs with an engineer. 

- A bias toward shipping: you’d rather get something working and iterate than spend weeks in design. 

Bonus points for 

- Full-stack development experience - particularly with Streamlit, FastAPI, or HTMX. 

- Experience building and managing REST APIs, including authentication, rate limiting, and documentation. 

- Familiarity with renewable energy, infrastructure investment, or financial services data. 

- Experience evaluating and adopting AI/ML tooling to augment engineering workflows. 

💚 Why else you'll love it here 

- 💰 Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!

- 🎉 Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! We were recently named the UK's top company to work for , and we ranked in the top ten in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2024 . Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership 

Our process usually takes up to 4 weeks, but we’ll always do our best to flex around what works for you. Along the way, you’ll chat with our recruitment team and your Recruiter will help you throughout different stages. Got any burning questions before then? Drop us a message at and we’d love to help! 

If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you. 🚀 

Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. Need any specific accommodations? Whether you require specific accommodations or have a unique preference, let us know, and we'll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic! 

Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. Across Octopus, we're looking for genuinely decent people who are honest and empathetic. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities, an inclusive work environment, and fairness for everyone.

- Tu as un solide bagage en analyse et pilotage de données , comme Analytics Engineer ou Data analyst par exemple ; idéalement dans les secteurs de la finance ou de la Tech,

- Tu as au moins une 1ère expérience en management direct ,

- Tu es rigoureux·se et proactif·ve dans l’amélioration de tes reportings et des tes analyses

- Tu t’appropries tes sujets et tu les fais avancer,

- Tu sais gérer des projets impliquant de multiples équipes en interne,

- Tu es à l’aise avec les outils de visualisation de données d’une manière générale,

- Tu es capable de synthétiser des analyses de manière claire , en quelques slides ou lignes par exemple.

Les plus : 

- Tu as une connaissances des sujets recouvrement / crédit ("plus" supplémentaire si c'est dans le secteur/contexte de l'Énergie),

- Tu as une connaissance des environnements data/cloud (GCP), et des outils d'automatisation,

- Tu as une connaissance du Machine Learning et de l’IA.

Ce poste est fait pour toi si : 

- Tu aimes contribuer et faire avancer la stratégie d’une équipe

- Tu es pédagogue et as envie de participer à la montée en compétences technique de ton équipe

- Tu sais travailler de manière collaborative et avec différentes équipes

- Tu es un·e problem-solver et tu fais avancer tes projets

- Tu es rigoureux·se et proactif·ve

- Tu sais travailler en Français et en Anglais (niveau min C1), pour pouvoir communiquer avec nos collègues du groupe et d’outre-Manche 

- Tu partages notre ambition de révolutionner le monde de l’énergie !

Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailer chez nous ? 

Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit !

Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment !

title: Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineer, Fraud Prevention)
description:
About the role 

Perplexity's fraud prevention team protects our products, users, and infrastructure from fraud and abuse across the whole lifecycle: sign-up, authentication, payments, API usage, and product features. We build and operate a real-time decisioning platform together with the surrounding systems: data pipelines for detection and model training, integrations with product and payment systems, and internal tooling for investigation and response. As a software engineer on the team, you will own services end to end, from design to production operations, and work closely with fraud analysts, ML engineers, and product teams to make abuse expensive and legitimate usage frictionless.

Responsibilities 

- Design, build, and operate high-throughput, low-latency backend services for fraud detection and prevention

- Build data pipelines and real-time feature computation that power detections and ML models

- Collect and process trust signals

title: Data Scientist (Measurement & Signal Processing) (f/m/d)
description:
Description 

QuantumDiamonds is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. Our Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development owns the chain from raw quantum sensor data to the current map an engineer can act on: the statistical evaluation of the sensor signal, the simulation and training data pipelines, the reconstruction of fields and currents, with the machine learning pipeline for three-dimensional current in production today, and the validation of every map against simulation and reference measurements.

We are looking for a Data Scientist to own one question for the team: can we trust this map, and if not, where in the chain did it go wrong? Every measurement, in our lab or at a customer, gets a verdict and a reason. You build the checks that produce it, keep the catalogue of known artifacts and reference measurements behind it, and make it automatic for the routine cases so that your judgement goes to the hard ones. When a check fails, you trace it to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Our Applications engineers, who run the customer projects, rely on your verdict for what reaches the customer. A senior data scientist on the team backs you on the hard calls at the start; the aim is that you become the owner of this question.

This is a hands-on analysis role, not a research position: the data is real, the chain is in daily use, and every improvement you make shows up in the next measurement. Your background does not need to be in quantum sensing or semiconductors: if you have learned to tell signal from noise, calibration errors and artifacts in another demanding measurement system, we want to hear from you.

Who we are 

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join QuantumDiamonds? 

Picture this: 

- Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

- Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

- Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

- An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us? 

- You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

- From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

- Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

- You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible! 

What will you do 

- Build the checks, from raw quantum sensor signal to field map, that tell a trustworthy measurement from a measurement or reconstruction artifact, on lab and customer data alike.

- Trace a failed check to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not.

- Keep the catalogue of known artifacts and the set of reference measurements that make every new verdict faster and more defensible.

- Validate the team's evaluation methods against simulation and reference measurements before they go into daily use.

- Give our Applications Engineers and the team a clear verdict on each measurement, and feed what breaks back into the next generation of the QDm.

What is expected of you 

- 3+ years of professional experience outside academia applying data science to measurement or imaging data from physical instruments.

- A degree in physics, electrical engineering, applied mathematics or a related discipline; a PhD is welcome, not required.

- Solid statistics and signal or image processing: you ask where a signal comes from, tell it from noise and systematics, and show it with numbers.

- Fluency in Python and the scientific stack, with version control and tests as a habit.

- AI coding agents are part of how you work, and you check their output the way you check your own.

- Comfortable operating our systems in the lab when your analysis needs data.

- Fluent English; German is an advantage, not a requirement. On-site in Munich.

Experience with magnetic or electromagnetic measurements or semiconductor failure analysis is a plus. What we cannot teach on the job is rigor with real measurement data and the habit of turning one analysis into a method the team can reuse, and that is exactly what we want you to bring.

Our benefits 

- Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

- Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

- Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

- Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

- Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

- Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.

- Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

About us 

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

title: Intern Deployment Engineer - Data & AI
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team 

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact — understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our team pairs deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role 

As an intern, you will have the unique opportunity to learn and grow through hands-on experiences. Your role will involve utilizing our cutting-edge AI deployment tools to develop innovative solutions for our customers, together with more experienced Deployment Engineers.

This is not a traditional engineering role where you build everything manually. You will be introduced to AI-augmented and business-focused software delivery: helping specify what needs to be built, learning to direct AI agents to execute, and assisting in validating the results. Participation in team meetings and workshops will offer valuable insights into the decision-making process within the company.

The Work You’ll Do 

Initiate and Connect 

- Conduct customer-facing sessions with experienced Deployment Engineers to discuss ongoing projects, translate strategic objectives into use cases, and receive guidance on best practices.

- Assist in gathering and organizing relevant data from various sources, ensuring data accuracy and consistency for analysis.

Build 

- Learn to direct AI deployment agents (like Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards by helping to write clear specifications.

- Conduct exploratory data analysis, utilizing Celonis and other tools to uncover trends, process inefficiencies, and root causes.

- Assist in defining the initial solution design blueprint and configuring operational solutions across the platform.

Value & Rollout 

- Support the validation of AI-generated outputs for accuracy and business relevance alongside senior team members.

- Help develop and maintain KPIs to track the success of project initiatives and quantify business impact.

- Assist in documenting solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and customer handover.

What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era 

- You will learn to work with AI agents as your primary tools, focusing on validating and refining their output rather than writing every line of code manually.

- You will develop foundational specification and context engineering skills to help translate business needs into precise AI instructions.

- As you navigate a fast-paced environment, you will learn how to adapt quickly to changes and new approaches as AI capabilities evolve.

The Qualifications You Need 

- Student of Technology Management, Business (-Informatics), Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a comparable degree program with outstanding performance.

- Know-how in Business Intelligence, data analytics, and a foundational understanding of enterprise business processes.

- Experience in programming and working with databases; knowledge in SQL, Python, or related coding- and/or database query languages.

- Curiosity and basic familiarity with AI-assisted development tools, coupled with an eagerness to learn prompt/context engineering.

- Interest in working with customers, along with awesome presentation and communication skills.

- Ability to demonstrate initiative, work independently, and think outside of the box.

- Fluent in English and German (any additional language is a plus).

- At least 5 months of full-time availability.

What Celonis can offer you: 

- Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.

- Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

- Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

- Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.

- Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.

- Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.

- Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.

- Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

- Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us: 

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video .

Celonis Inclusion Statement: 

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. 

Your Privacy:

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process .

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools 

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. title: Experimentation & Tracking engineer
description:
🧡 About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place: serving merchants and consumers.

Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience, without encouraging bad debt.

As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over 25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.

With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

👐 About the team

You will join the Growth team and work closely with Revenue Operations, Account Managers, Business Analysts, Marketing, Data, and merchant technical teams. You will help Alma apply to its own website the experimentation and measurement expertise we bring to merchants.

This is a permanent, full-time position based in Paris, with a hybrid working model. Professional French and English are required.

💼 About the job

As an Experimentation & Tracking Engineer, you will own web experimentation at Alma: the A/B tests we run on merchant websites, the measurement of what happens on our own website, and its continued development following our recent redesign.

Your responsibilities will include:

Lead merchant experimentation from opportunity to readout 

- Qualify testing opportunities against technical and volume eligibility criteria, then design each test with the merchant: scenario, traffic split, pages, events, KPIs, duration, and stopping rule.

- Implement variations and event tracking in Kameleoon, run the live phase, check data quality, and present the first results to the merchant alongside the Account Manager and Business Analysts.

Own web tracking and measurement quality 

- Define and maintain the tracking plan for Alma's website across 8 markets, implementing it through GTM, GA4, or equivalent tools.

- Ensure reliable data flows into Salesforce, BigQuery, and Looker, while owning consent and GDPR compliance, deduplication, attribution, and reconciliation across sources.

Build and optimize almapay.com 

- Build and evolve landing pages, product pages, market pages, and local content following the website redesign.

- Run a CRO programme on Alma's own funnels, starting with the demo request, while maintaining performance, Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, and hreflang across markets.

Scale the experimentation practice 

- Turn the existing framework, documentation, and tooling into a repeatable practice, with a target of 8 merchant tests going live over the year.

- Share standards, learnings, and results with Growth, Revenue Operations, Data, Marketing, Sales, and Product stakeholders.

🧰 You will work with

Kameleoon, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Salesforce, BigQuery, Looker, Looker Studio, Metabase, n8n, Make, Notion, Slack, GitHub.

🧩 About you

To succeed in this job

- You have 3 to 5 years of experience in experimentation, web analytics, CRO, or measurement-oriented web development.

- You have hands-on experience with GTM and GA4, or equivalent tools, including consent mode, data quality, and debugging issues that can fail silently.

- You are self-sufficient in JavaScript and HTML/CSS, including DOM manipulation, variation building, and debugging on websites you did not build and cannot fully control.

- You understand the fundamentals of test validity, including sample size, stopping rules, and what makes an experiment result trustworthy. You are also comfortable working with clients and technical stakeholders in French and English.

And it will be nice if you also

- Have an e-commerce or payments background, with familiarity with checkout journeys.

- Can use SQL to pull and investigate your own data.

- Have worked with Kameleoon, Optimizely, AB Tasty, VWO, or a similar experimentation platform.

- Speak Spanish, Italian, or German.

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity, and the ability to grow as much as experience.

🧘 What's in it for you

If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:

- Owning a broad, high-impact scope as Alma's internal reference for experimentation and tracking, with the autonomy to shape the practice.

- Seeing the direct business outcomes of your work: your tests inform how Alma wins and retains merchants, and your findings are presented to real customers.

- Working across dozens of merchant websites, 8 markets, and several CMS platforms, while being supported by a central Data team and Business Analysts for deeper analysis.

🤑 Compensation & Benefits

- Competitive salary based on 12 months

- Profit-sharing and employee savings plan

- Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma, including family package

- Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma

- Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and ClassPass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities

- Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at a 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.

- Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD): €544.80/year, excluding full-remote contracts

- Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma

- Mental health: free access to the MindDay platform

- Paid time off: 25 days/year, plus additional paid leave for employees on executive contracts

- Access to our Learning & Development Platform

- 2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer

🎯 Interview Process

- Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member to understand your background and motivation, and present the role.

- Video call with the hiring manager from Revenue Operations & Growth to discuss the role, the team, your experience, and your questions.

- Practical case: scope an A/B test from a real merchant scenario and present your approach, including project management.

- Cross-interviews with a Sales or Account Management stakeholder and a Business Analyst you will work with.

- Final conversation with leadership.

🌍 Diversity & Inclusion

At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels seen, respected, and empowered to do their best work whatever their gender, background, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or lived experience. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all walks of life, and all employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

title: Data Center Hardware Engineer
description:
About Mistral 

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The mission 

You will work every day on the racks that power one of France's largest AI clusters.

Mistral's compute footprint is our single largest investment and the foundation of our AI research and engineering. We're hiring Data Center Hardware Engineers to keep our GPU/CPU clusters healthy, safe and growing — hands-on, in the data center, at the intersection of high-performance computing and physical infrastructure.

You'll join a small, senior team working at a scale few engineers get to experience: GPU-dense racks (H100/H200-class and next-generation platforms), high-speed interconnects, liquid-cooled systems — with new sites under development in France and beyond.

Hardware here is not someone else's problem. As part of a small on-site team, you carry responsibility for it end to end.

Location: On-site at one of our data center in Bessé-sur-Braye, Pays de la Loire.

What you'll do 

- Diagnose & repair server and cluster hardware: CPUs, memory, drives, NICs, GPUs, PSUs, and interconnect problems (switches, cables, transceivers; Ethernet/InfiniBand).

- Intervene safely — power-off/lockout, ESD discipline, pre/post-work checklists, tidy and safe work areas.

- Capture everything — photos, serials, test results; open, update and close tickets with notes the next engineer can act on.

- Manage parts — receive, label and track inventory; run RMAs and coordinate with vendors.

- Help us get better — feed recurring anomalies into monitoring, alerts and SOPs; contribute small scripts (Python/Bash) if you have those skills.

- Be a good teammate — clear status updates, honest handovers, and respect for the people depending on the cluster.

About you 

- Hands-on comfort in data centers or server hardware — you can (or will quickly learn to) work cleanly in racks: rails, cabling, labeling, mounting.

- Disciplined and meticulous: checklists aren't bureaucracy to you, they're craftsmanship.

- Practical electrical basics: power-off procedures, PPE, short-circuit risk awareness.

- Basic Linux (boot checks, logs) — scripting is a plus, not a requirement.

- Physically able to work in racks (lift, mount, maneuver) in a data center environment.

- Comfortable in a 24/7 operation, including a rotating on-call with emergency response expectations.

- Driver's licence (B) for travel between our sites.

Even if you don't match every criterion 

Many of our best hardware engineers came from research labs, telecoms, IT services or the military. If you are rigorous, curious and genuinely motivated by hardware at scale, we would be glad to hear from you — we assess demonstrated scope rather than keyword matching.

Nice to have 

- HPC/AI/cloud production experience at scale; large-fleet server install and maintenance.

- Networking fundamentals (Ethernet/InfiniBand) beyond basics.

- Vendor/RMA tooling, ticketing (Jira/ServiceNow), inventory systems.

- Python/Bash automation for checks, capture, inventory or reporting.

What We Offer 

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page .

Privacy Policy 

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy .

title: Ingénieur en mécanique des fluides
company: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
description:
ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

- la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

- la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Unité de Formation et de Recherche (UFR) Mécanique. L’UFR de Mécanique a pour mission d’assurer la formation en mécanique des élèves du cursus ingénieur d’ENSTA, des élèves de masters de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, et la formation par la recherche d’étudiants français et étrangers au niveau master et doctorat. L’Unité développe également des activités de recherche dans le domaine de la mécanique des matériaux et des structures, de la mécanique des fluides, des vibrations et de l’acoustique. Ces activités sont réalisées grâce à un important parc expérimental de haut niveau en mécanique des solides et des fluides, tant pour l’enseignement que la recherche. Sur le campus de Brest, l’UFR de Mécanique compte une cinquantaine d’enseignants chercheurs, une cinquantaine de doctorants/post-doctorants ainsi qu’une dizaine de personnels techniques (ingénieurs, techniciens). Les activités de recherche des membres de l’UFR de Mécanique du site de Brest sont menées au sein de l’Institut de Recherche Dupuy de Lôme (IRDL, CNRS UMR 6027, www.irdl.fr ). La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs de l’ENSTA, pôle thématique de recherche « Structure Interaction Fluide (StIF) » de l’IRDL.

Le recrutement s’inscrit dans le projet MULTIRIM, qui vise à développer des solutions innovantes en propulsion marine. Les propulseurs marins à entraînement circonférentiel constituent une alternative aux hélices classiques marines, en présentant plusieurs avantages : manoeuvrabilité, compacité, discrétion acoustique, amélioration de la traînée de la carène par l’absence de ligne d’arbre. Cependant, la présence d’une tuyère embarquant le moteur électrique d’entraînement pénalise le rendement. Une piste d’amélioration est d’adopter un propulseur à plusieurs étages à l’instar des moteurs d’avion, afin de regagner environ vingt points de rendement. La configuration même de l’entraînement extérieur, sans arbre, supprime la complexité mécanique rencontrée sur les hélices contrarotatives classiques.

Or, il existe très peu de bancs d’essai pour les propulseurs à entraînement circonférentiel, pour une seule hélice, ainsi que très peu de données expérimentales de référence. Les difficultés sont de deux ordres. Du point de vue fonctionnement, le refroidissement du moteur électrique nécessite des échanges thermiques, et la liaison rotor/stator est assurée par un palier hydrodynamique. La mise ne eau dans une veine hydrodynamique est ainsi obligatoire. Par ailleurs, l’absence d’arbre d’entraînement empêche une mesure aisée du couple d’entraînement, valeur requise pour déterminer le rendement global du propulseur.

Intégrer plusieurs étages propulsifs au sein d’un même propulseur au sein d’un banc d’essai expérimental n’a jamais été proposé au niveau international. Cependant, le mode de fonctionnement de l’entraînement circonférentiel le permet aisément.

Disposer de résultats expérimentaux de référence, tant pour les efforts globaux que pour l’écoulement (champ de vitesse, de pression) présente un intérêt fort pour la communauté scientifique. En particulier, l'écoulement fortement tourbillonnaire, la présence d'éléments tournants rendent la simulation numérique particulièrement difficile et des résultats de référence permettront de valider les modèles numériques.

Aussi, le premier objectif de ce projet est de développer un banc d’essais modulaire, afin de tester plusieurs configurations d’hélices, de vitesses d’entraînement différenciées, de formes de tuyère, et évaluer précisément le rendement global. D’autre part, le principe des moteurs à plusieurs étages est de récupérer la puissance perdue par le premier étage, en redressant l’écoulement, un propulseur idéal accélérant l’écoulement uniquement de manière axiale. Un second objectif du projet consiste à caractériser cette récupération d’énergie opérée par les étages supérieurs.

Le projet associe les compétences en modélisation de machines électriques de l’IRENav et les compétences en modélisation hydrodynamique de l’ENSTA-IRDL (UMR CNRS 6027) et de l’IRENav. L’ENSTA met par ailleurs à disposition sa veine aérodynamique dédiée aux applications marines, et l’instrumentation associée. Ce projet s’inscrit dans un projet plus vaste financé par l’Agence Innovation Défense (Projet AID RD-PROP), visant à proposer des méthodologies de modélisation et de conception de propulseurs électriques navals intégrés à entrainement circonférentiel. La personne recrutée sera intégrée dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire de 3 enseignants-chercheurs, 1 doctorante et 2 post-doctorantes.

Missions / Activités principales : 

La personne recrutée prendra en charge la conception et le test d’un banc d’essai multi-étages pour propulseur à entraînement circonférentiel, pour usage en veine aérodynamique. La caractérisation du rendement du propulseur sera réalisée par mesure directe des efforts, et mesure indirecte de la vorticité résiduelle dans le sillage aval à l’aide de mesures non intrusives du champ de vitesse (méthode PIV).

La personne recrutée sera amenée à produire des rapports et présentations techniques, mettre en œuvre des essais (étalonnage, mesure d’efforts, velocimétrie laser), et travailler de manière collaborative avec l’ensemble des partenaires du projet RD-PROP.

Les missions détaillées sont les suivantes :

Tâche 1 : Conception et fabrication d’un banc moteur dédié 

La conception d’un banc d’essai propulseur s’appuiera sur les compétences de la plateforme de conception MASMECA de l’ENSTA, ainsi que sur l’expertise de l’IRENav sur les moteurs à entraînement circonférentiel. Le banc d’essai sera prévu pour être modulaire, et fonctionner dans une gamme de vitesses de rotation représentative d’un propulseur réel.

Tâche 2 : Détermination du rendement maximal atteignable 

Parallèlement à la conception et la fabrication du banc moteur, un modèle semi-analytique (disque actuateur sous tuyère) sera développé, afin de proposer une estimation théorique du rendement maximal atteignable par un propulseur sous tuyère. Cette estimation prendra en compte la traînée de la tuyère, l’absence de flux transverse dans le sillage aval. La principale simplification concerne le frottement visqueux sur les pales, non pris en compte par ce type de modèle.

Tâche 3 : Méthodologie de quantification de l’écoulement transverse 

Une méthodologie de détermination du champ de vitesses par technique PIV non intrusive dans un plan du sillage sera mise en œuvre, à l’aide d’un laser, d’une caméra rapide et d’un ensemencement de l’écoulement. L’influence de la position de la section transverse par rapport au corps étudié sera étudiée, ainsi que les paramètres numériques de l’algorithme PIV. Différents indicateurs de champ de vitesse intégré seront testés, pour qualifier au mieux la signature de perte de rendement lié à l’écoulement transverse. La méthodologie développée sera validée sur un écoulement classique de la littérature.

Tâche 4 : Mise en œuvre d’un benchmark de référence dans la veine aérodynamique de l’ENSTA 

Le banc d’essai sera utilisé pour une première conception d’un jeu d’hélices contrarotatives (2 étages), adaptées au rim-driven, et d’une géométrie de tuyère simplifiée. Ces premiers tests exploratoires permettront de valider la chaîne complète de test (banc + instrumentation des efforts + post-traitement sillage aval) dans l’objectif de publier à terme un benchmark de référence au niveau international.

Les résultats obtenus pourront mener à publication scientifique.

company: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
description:
ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

- la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

- la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Unité de Formation et de Recherche (UFR) Mécanique. L’UFR de Mécanique a pour mission d’assurer la formation en mécanique des élèves du cursus ingénieur d’ENSTA, des élèves de masters de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, et la formation par la recherche d’étudiants français et étrangers au niveau master et doctorat. L’Unité développe également des activités de recherche dans le domaine de la mécanique des matériaux et des structures, de la mécanique des fluides, des vibrations et de l’acoustique. Ces activités sont réalisées grâce à un important parc expérimental de haut niveau en mécanique des solides et des fluides, tant pour l’enseignement que la recherche. Sur le campus de Brest, l’UFR de Mécanique compte une cinquantaine d’enseignants chercheurs, une cinquantaine de doctorants/post-doctorants ainsi qu’une dizaine de personnels techniques (ingénieurs, techniciens). Les activités de recherche des membres de l’UFR de Mécanique du site de Brest sont menées au sein de l’Institut de Recherche Dupuy de Lôme (IRDL, CNRS UMR 6027, www.irdl.fr ). La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs de l’ENSTA, pôle thématique de recherche « Structure Interaction Fluide (StIF) » de l’IRDL.

Le recrutement s’inscrit dans le projet SUBPERF-AI, qui porte sur une démarche de réduction drastique du cycle de développement de nouveaux concepts sous-marins, en s’appuyant sur les progrès récents de l’intelligence artificielle (IA), et plus particulièrement le machine learning. Au contraire de l’existant en IA basé sur des modèles ininterprétables de type boîte noire, le projet vise à construire une méthodologie de construction de modèles physiques, de complexité adaptée à la physique sous-jacente, en ayant recours à l’expertise humaine et se plaçant comme un outil de conception complémentaire dans l’écosystème existant.

Les objectifs principaux du projet sont :

- Développer une méthodologie de détermination automatisée du modèle d’efforts hydrodynamiques de corps sous-marin, avec utilisation de l’IA (machine learning), sur la base des données de la cinématique, des trajectoires, et des paramètres de contrôle, facilement accessibles, lors des essais maquette ou réel, ou lors d’une simulation numérique.

- Placer l’expert humain en capacité de contrôler la construction du modèle aux différents stades : qualité des données d’entrée, qualité de la phase d’apprentissage du modèle, et outils/règles de certification a posteriori.

La personne recrutée sera intégrée dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire de 3 enseignants-chercheurs, un doctorant et un second post-doctorant.

Missions / Activités principales : 

La personne recrutée prendra en charge la construction d’un modèle d’effort hydrodynamique « expert » et la génération de données expérimentales. Le modèle hydrodynamique expert sera déterminé en suivant la méthodologie classique de l’ITTC, à l’aide d’une campagne d’essais dans la veine aérodynamique pour la caractérisation des efforts (essais en modèle captif du type PMM (Planar Motion Mechanism)). Ce modèle sera implémenté dans un simulateur temporel, dont les résultats seront confrontés sur des manœuvres standards réalisées dans le bassin à drones de l’ENSTA. La confrontation des résultats de trajectoires expérimentales aux trajectoires simulées, obtenues sur la base des essais en modèle captif, pourra amener à questionner la méthodologie standard, en particulier lors de la présence de non-linéarités importantes ou de termes croisés non négligeables. Les essais en bassin fourniront par ailleurs les données de cinématique nécessaires au travail de thèse.

Les missions détaillées sont les suivantes :

Tâche 1 – conception et fabrication d’un drone sous-marin 

Conception d’un drone générique de géométrie simplifiée, et instrumenté. Le drone recevra un capotage extérieur, afin de tester plusieurs configurations : géométrie parallélépipédique typique d’un ROV d’exploration, et géométrie cylindrique de type drone torpille.

Le drone sera instrumenté pour mesurer les paramètres de contrôle, la cinématique et les trajectoires, ainsi que les efforts propulsifs (poussée, couple) et les efforts de contrôle.

Tâche 2 – essais statiques et dynamiques en modèle captif 

Réalisation d’essais de caractérisation dans la veine aérodynamique de l’ENSTA, en similitude complète de Reynolds, pour les vitesses envisagées d’utilisation en eau du drone.

Mesure des efforts en statique, sur les 6 degrés de liberté. Caractérisation des efforts de plans porteurs et du propulseur.

Mesure des efforts en dynamique, en mouvement forcé à l’aide de l’hexapode : masses et inerties ajoutées, termes liés aux vitesses angulaires.

Tâche 3 – Identification dérivées hydrodynamiques 

Identification des dérivées hydrodynamiques (ou coefficients hydrodynamiques) à partir des essais en modèle captif.

Tâche 4 – Adaptation du simulateur temporel 

Prise en main du simulateur temporel de l’ENSTA, et de l’environnement de développement.

Adaptation du code de calcul pour intégrer des lois de commande issues de mesures expérimentales.

Tâche 5 – Essais libres et standardisés, en bassin 

Réalisation d’essais aux trajectoires prédéfinies (zigzag horizontal ou vertical, accélération horizontale, …).

Réalisation d’essais pour parcourir l’espace complet des 6 degrés de libertés.

Enregistrement de l’historique des contrôles (vitesse hélice, angles plans porteurs, …), des trajectoires et des efforts des organes de contrôle.

Tâche 6 – Rejeu trajectoires simulateur temporel 

Rejeu numérique des trajectoires, afin de valider si le modèle d’efforts est suffisamment complet pour prédire correctement les trajectoires mesurées expérimentalement.

Les résultats obtenus amèneront à publication scientifique.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
description:
About Nebius: 

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Role Summary

Nebius Token Factory is building production-grade inference for open-source, customer, and internally optimized models. This role owns the path from model artifact to fast, reliable, cost-efficient endpoint. The work sits at the intersection of model internals, inference engines, serving architecture, benchmarking, and production deployment.

What You Will Do

- 
Own a platform-level optimization pillar such as quantization, speculative decoding, KV -cache optimization, engine selection, or long-context serving.

- 
Create reusable evaluation, benchmarking, and rollout frameworks across multiple model families.

- 
Provide technical direction to MLEs, Applied Scientists, GPU kernel engineers, and infrastructure engineers on shared performance goals.

- 
Optimize LLM and VLM endpoints for latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.

- 
Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, or similar systems.

- 
Build and productionize model-compression workflows, including quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.

- 
Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV -cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving.

- 
Build reproducible benchmark harnesses for TTFT , TPOT , tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token.

- 
Partner with GPU kernel engineers and platform engineers to diagnose bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.

- 
Write clear design docs, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.

Required Qualifications

- 
Strong Python and PyTorch engineering skills.

- 
Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM , or high-throughput transformer inference systems.

- 
Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or equivalent internal systems.

- 
Strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks, including KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.

- 
Ability to reason quantitatively about latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost tradeoffs.

- 
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.

Preferred Qualifications

- 
Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8 , INT8 , INT4 , NVFP4 , MXFP4 , AWQ , GPTQ , SmoothQuant, or related techniques.

- 
Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or other inference acceleration methods.

-

title: Lead Software Engineer (Hybrid)
description:
Lead Engineer 

Location : Waterloo, London, England, UK | Hybrid (1 day per week in office)

Who We Are 

At 8th Light, we bring life to the best ideas.

Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Chicago, we are a technology solutions consultancy that partners with organisations from early-stage startups to the world's largest companies. We take on hard software challenges and turn them into durable results. We build agentic products, the platforms they run on, and the engineering and design at every layer.

Our commitment to quality means we deliver solutions we’re truly proud of, while our curiosity sparks innovation and breakthrough thinking. 8th Lights thrive in an environment that champions continuous education, fueling our growth through mentorship and hands-on work. We foster an open, collaborative culture grounded in honesty that builds trust, and believe true success is measured by the outcomes we create for our clients.

If this kind of work and our kind of people energises you, you’ve found the right place.

Who You Are 

You’ve shown long-term repeated success on a variety of projects, typically over the course of 7+ years. You can be the go-to leader for any software development engagement. You have a broad and deep range of expertise that allows you to make an immediate impact on projects. In your previous experience, you have:

- Successfully led high-stakes consulting engagements from discovery to production 

- Built high-quality, maintainable software collaboratively, incrementally, and through an approach tailored towards the unique needs of the clients you’ve served 

- Written production-quality code using a variety of languages and frameworks, including but not limited to: Java, C#/.NET, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Go, Ruby, Scala, R, and SQL

- Leveraged AI-assistive development tools for tasks like scaffolding, refactoring, debugging, test generation, and documentation

- Experience building or integrating AI/ML-powered features into products or systems (e.g., recommendation engines, NLP models, computer vision, predictive analytics) 

- Used context-appropriate automated testing to inform software design choices and catch bugs

- Debugged and refactored pre-existing code to incrementally improve it

- Collaborated with teams using Git, MacOS/Linux, and CI/CD

- Remedied architecture-level concerns such as scalability, security, reliability, and performance

- Brought together people from different functions and perspectives in forums that encourage idea sharing, collaboration, and problem solving

- Made thoughtful recommendations and set direction in the face of ambiguity

- Mentored and shared knowledge with colleagues

- Actively sought out and effectively given feedback

- Communicated empathically with stakeholders and colleagues

- Collaboratively led stakeholders to balance technical considerations with product and user needs

What You’ll Do At 8th Light 

As a lead technologist on projects, you’ll work with a variety of clients, typically one to two in a year, through a variety of technologies and frameworks over the course of your career with us. You’ll lead more complicated projects, leading teams to do so. You’ll work with colleagues who share your passion for technology solutions. You’ll invest time developing your skills and sharing what you know. You’ll be responsible for:

- Making immediate contributions to projects, rapidly building trust with clients

- Working pragmatically to balance technology choices while delivering high-quality work within deadlines

- Leading architecture and software design discussions

- Collaborating on systems that involve the full ML lifecycle from data ingestion and preprocessing, to model deployment, integration, and performance monitoring

- Generating new potential solutions to challenges (technical and non-technical) in partnership with team members and clients

- Leading or initiating formal feedback conversations with teams and clients via retrospectives

- Clearly articulating and documenting outcomes and driving forward action items

- Contributing to the health of your team and 8th Light’s culture by modeling our Values

- Ensuring your team has a healthy, prioritized, estimated backlog

- Managing high-level project roadmaps as the team lead for large engagements

- Maintaining relationships with client technical leaders

- Regular syncs with the client to provide status updates, and for identifying and evaluating risks and presenting potential solutions

- Identifying, mitigating, and resolving blockers to team progress

- Contributing to 8th Light by serving as a mentor, leading or designing workshops internally or for clients, representing 8th Light in the tech community, or supporting our hiring processes

Strongly Preferred Skills 

We work across many areas, and encourage anyone with the experience listed above to apply. We would particularly like to encourage applicants with experience in the following areas:

- Platform engineering: building reusable software foundations, internal developer platforms, and infrastructure that other teams build on

- Data Engineering: including platforms like Databricks for data processing and analytics

- Delivering production agentic systems, including RAG pipelines, vector search, and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, and n8n

- DevSecOps & DevOps

- MLOps

- Infrastructure as Code

Building a truly diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace is an ongoing journey, and we’re excited to keep learning and growing together. We have a proud tradition of hiring talented colleagues with real-world career experiences. 

How You’ll be Supported 

At 8th Light, we believe our people are our greatest asset. Their growth, well-being, and success shape our future. 

- Our wellness package is designed with the Whole YOU in mind and includes:

- A robust L&D programme featuring unlimited access to thousands of books, courses, and expert-led training on the O'Reilly learning platform.

- Annual financial stipend and time allotment for learning & development

- Coworking support for our global team

- 12 weeks of new parent leave available for eligible employees

See our full list of Benefits . 

A Note on Compensation 

At 8th Light, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that is transparent, fair, and helps us attract and retain top talent in alignment with our company’s strategic growth goals and clients’ needs.

We benchmark our salaries using Geographic Structures to establish competitive pay ranges within the regions where 8th Lights live. Our pay ranges for our Lead Engineer position within London is: £76,023-95,029 GBP. 

Reach out to ----- for more relevant information pertaining to your local market.

8th Light Hubs and Geographies 

8th Light's culture is rooted in strong connections that extend across our teams, regions, and beyond client work. We are a distributed team across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom, with hubs in Chicago, London, Los Angeles, New York, and Seattle. 

- London Co-working: Employees working from our London hub follow a hybrid model, which includes a minimum of one day per week in our Waterloo Office. This co-working day is designed to encourage collaboration and further strengthen our community.In most cases, our consulting engagements do not require travel.

We hope to see you apply! 

#LI-Hybrid

A Note on Your Privacy

At 8th Light, one of our core values is Honesty that builds trust — and that shapes how we approach hiring. We want you to have a clear picture of who we are , what we're looking for , and how we handle your information throughout the process.

Before submitting your application, please take a moment to review our Global Candidate Privacy Notice . By applying, you acknowledge that you've read it.

https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ditto https://docs.ditto.live/home/about-ditto I've been obsessed with CRDTs since I first saw them at Strange Loop years ago, and I still can't quite believe I now get to work on them for a living — in some of the most challenging environments there are: disconnected, degraded, contested, out where the cloud isn't. If that's your kind of problem, come build with us. Ditto is the edge-native data platform that keeps distributed systems in sync when the network doesn't cooperate — an offline-first, CRDT-based layer syncing any device (phone, vehicle, sensor, server) over Bluetooth LE, P2P Wi-Fi, LAN, and tactical radio, with or without connectivity. Same core, commercial to defense; operationally deployed and network-agnostic. The problems are the fun kind: conflict-free replication with no server and no synchronized clock, multi-transport routing that never drops the connection, moving a coherent picture over links as thin as an HF radio shot, and human-in-the-loop robotics/autonomy where a detection may have to be physically carried by a moving node. Concept to field in days, not months. Most roles are open to anyone authorized to work in the U.S.; Public Sector and forward-deployed roles require U.S. person status. Job Summary 

This position is on the team building StrongDM, now part of Delineaâthe universal access management platform that secures and audits access to databases, servers, Kubernetes clusters, and web applications. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will apply deep expertise across distributed systems, security, and cloud architecture to help shape the technical direction of StrongDMâs proxy and control-plane platform. You will take on the platformâs most complex and ambiguous engineering challenges, exercise independent judgment on architecture and design decisions that span multiple teams, and serve as a recognized subject matter expert on secure, high-scale distributed systems written in Go. You will report to the teamâs engineering manager.

What Youâll Do:

- Lead the architecture and technical direction of highly concurrent, distributed backend systems in Go (Golang), setting engineering standards that extend across multiple teams within StrongDM and Delinea.

- Drive design decisions for the proxy data plane (gateways and relays) and control-plane services, evaluating tradeoffs on the platformâs most complex and ambiguous technical problems.

- Partner with architects, product managers, and DevOps/SRE leadership to shape multi-quarter system roadmaps, translating broader business priorities into concrete technical strategy.

- Serve as a subject matter expert on secure network protocols and cryptographic systems (TLS/mTLS, credential brokering, key management), guiding their application across the platform.

- Lead code and design reviews across teams, holding a high bar for performance, security, and maintainability, and coach engineers on applying that bar independently.

- Investigate and resolve the most challenging technical issues in distributed, multi-cloud production environments, often requiring evaluation of ambiguous or intangible tradeoffs.

- Author and maintain architectural and technical strategy documentation that informs decisions beyond your immediate team.

- Mentor engineers across the team and may direct the work of others, building the cross-team relationships that help align engineering execution with company objectives.

What Youâll Need: 

- Bachelorâs or Masterâs degree in computer science, software engineering, or related technical discipline.

- 8+ years of professional experience working as a software engineer, with deep expertise in Go (Golang) , distributed systems, and backend/network service development at scale.

- Demonstrated experience architecting highly concurrent, distributed systems and exercising independent judgment on methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria, including Goâs standard networking and cryptography libraries.

- Strong understanding of distributed systems, network protocols, and API design (gRPC/Protobuf and/or RESTful APIs), with the ability to reason about tradeoffs across an entire system.

- Experience with AWS (or another major cloud provider) and cloud-native deployment models at production scale.

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to convey advanced technical concepts and persuade diverse stakeholders and audiences.

- Proven ability to build formal working relationships and coordinate across multiple teams and functions.

- Conceptual thinking skills sufficient to understand advanced technical issues and their broader implications for the business.

- Demonstrated track record mentoring engineers and being recognized as a subject matter expert others turn to for guidance.

Weâd Love to See: 

- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) beyond a single provider.

- Experience establishing or influencing engineering-wide standards for Terraform automation and CI/CD pipelines.

- Deep expertise with secure protocols, mTLS and PKI, secrets management (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault), and credential brokering.

- Familiarity with proxying database, SSH/RDP, Kubernetes, and HTTP traffic, and with building CLI or desktop client tooling.

- Experience shaping Zero Trust architecture strategy, just-in-time access models, and policy-as-code (e.g., Cedar) at an organizational level.

- We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

- We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

- What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

- Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

- Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

- Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

- Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

title: MixRank (YC S11) | Software Engineers | 100% Remote (Global) | Full-Time
description:
MixRank (YC S11) | Software Engineers | 100% Remote (Global) | Full-Time
MixRank processes petabytes of data every month through web crawling. Hundreds of customers use our data products, including Google, Amazon, Facebook, Intel, and Adobe, across industries such as finance, recruiting, sales, marketing, and security. We’re a fully remote company with a global footprint across 20+ countries. We’re growing, profitable, employee-owned, and have no dependence on outside funding. Applicants from all geographies and backgrounds are welcome. We’re looking for passionate individuals for whom programming is not just a job, but something they genuinely love to do. We’re obsessed with computers, programming, big data, databases, compilers, hardware, math, data science, and the internet. Does this sound like you? Please apply to join our team. Our codebase is friendly to new contributors. You’ll have a fully functional development environment within hours through full automation and will be pushing commits on your first day. Deployments to production happen multiple times per day and finish in under two minutes.Effectively all of our codebase is written in Python, Rust, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Nix. The core technologies you’ll need familiarity with to be productive are Python, PostgreSQL, Linux, and Git. We operate at a larger scale than typical startups. We run two datacenters with high-performance servers we’ve built ourselves, capable of handling the volumes of data we process. We’ve implemented our own distributed file system, perform full-scale web crawls, and download and run static analysis on the entire universe of published Android APKs and iOS IPAs. Unlike a typical startup where you might spend half your time in meetings and the other half fixing Jira tickets, at MixRank you’ll challenge yourself with difficult technical problems that help you grow as an individual. We’re continuously hiring for the positions below; these aren’t singular roles that close once filled. Our philosophy is that the candidate is more important than the position. For each new member of the team, we design a custom role and responsibilities around their interests.
Other companies may create a long list of specific requirements with the expectation that you’ll exactly replace someone on the team or fit a role defined by committee. MixRank is more pragmatic: we first get excited about bringing a unique individual onto the team, then figure out the best way to support their specific talents. Junior Software Engineer - Remote (Global), Full-Time We’re looking for remote junior engineers with 0–3 years of professional software experience and 5+ years of curiosity exploring computers, programming, and technical hobby projects. This is an open-ended entry role with mentorship and diverse opportunities to work across all areas of our product: databases, distributed systems, infrastructure and tooling, data analysis, machine learning, frontend/backend web development, APIs, data mining, data modeling, and more. To stand out, please highlight what makes you unique: passion for computing, curiosity and side projects, work ethic, niche research, or anything else that shows how you think and build. Ideally, you’ve already graduated. But if you still have one or more years left of school, please feel free to apply anyway. If you’re the right fit for the team, we’ll figure out a way to accommodate your schedule. Apply here: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/mixrank/jobs/Fnwsojk-j Software Engineer - Remote (Global), Full-Time We’re hiring generalist software engineers to work on web applications, data mining, machine learning/data science, data transformation/ETL, data modeling, database scaling, infrastructure, DevOps, and more. We’ll tailor the role to the subset of areas that best match your interests. Beneficial experience includes PostgreSQL, Python, Rust, Linux, TypeScript, Nix, frontend/backend web development, and data mining. Apply here: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/mixrank/jobs/RXQspen-s I’m Kiran, Chief of Staff at MixRank, a fully remote data startup building go-to-market intelligence. We’re US-incorporated but hire globally, and we’re bringing on new teammates to join a fast-moving team with real ownership and impact.

description: Prior Labs | Berlin, Freiburg, NYC | ONSITE | Full-time | Technical PM, ML Infra, Research Scientist/Engineer, Backend, Full Stack We build foundation models for tabular data. Deep learning transformed text and images but mostly skipped tables, which are still the data behind most clinical trials, financial models and scientific experiments. The reason is structural: no natural sequence, no spatial structure, no shared vocabulary across datasets, so the architectures and scaling laws behind LLMs don't transfer. Our approach: pre-train a transformer on millions of synthetic datasets sampled from causal-structure priors. The whole dataset goes in as context, predictions come out in one forward pass. No per-dataset training, no hyperparameter tuning, seconds instead of hours. TabPFN v2 was published in Nature and set a new state of the art; TabPFN-3 scales to 10M rows. 4M+ downloads, 8k+ GitHub stars, in production from liquid biopsy to rail maintenance. Models stay open, research stays public, same team and offices. Reports to me, close to the code. - ML Engineer, Infrastructure: own multi-cluster GPU infra (Slurm on GCP today, multi-provider next), training performance and the tooling layer. PhD plus top-venue publications, or equivalent. - Research Engineer, Foundation Model: same agenda from the engineering side. Python/FastAPI, Terraform, K8s. - Full Stack Engineer, ML Platform: build the product end to end. TypeScript + Python, React/FastAPI/Postgres.
